literal_meaning: ডান হাতের কাজ বা ব্যাপার (right hand's work or matter)
figurative_meaning_en: Food, provisions, eating, arrangement of meals
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঘরে ডানহাতের কাজের জন্য সবসময় খাবার রাখা আছে।
ভ্রমণে গেলে ডানহাতের কাজের ব্যবস্থা করে নাও।
example_sentences_in_english: Keep food at home for the essentials of daily sustenance.
Make arrangements for provisions before going on a trip.
note: The idiom appears to refer to essential, routine matters like food preparation, possibly implying familiarity or ease in handling daily necessities in Bengali household culture.
